# The Butler Realty

> Brian Butler, REALTOR® (eXp Realty, License #SA701819000) serves home buyers and sellers in San Tan Valley and Florence, Arizona.

Brian Butler is a licensed Arizona real estate agent with eXp Realty, specializing in residential real estate in San Tan Valley and Florence, Arizona. Four years of experience serving buyers and sellers in these markets.

- [Neighbors Push Back at San Tan Valley's First-Ever Annexation Hearing](https://thebutlerrealty.com/community-news/san-tan-valley/gantzel-road-annexation-hearing): San Tan Valley's Town Council took no vote at the town's first annexation hearing, for a 3.3-acre Gantzel Road parcel, as neighbors raised private-road and deed-restriction concerns.
- [San Tan Valley Sets Future Council Pay, Moves Forward on Impact Fee Study](https://thebutlerrealty.com/community-news/san-tan-valley/july-15-town-council-recap): San Tan Valley's July 15 Town Council meeting set future elected-official pay, adopted impact fee study groundwork, and heard reports from the town's new road contractor and fire department.
- [San Tan Valley Council Sets Future Mayor and Council Pay, Adopts Impact Fee Study Framework](https://thebutlerrealty.com/community-news/san-tan-valley/town-council-sets-future-leader-pay-impact-fees): New salaries take effect after the November 2026 election; the town lays legal groundwork for development impact fees, most of which currently start at zero.
